sv.title: Totalstopp på kärnkraftverk – kan ge ”dubbel effekt” på elpriset
sv.summary: Kärnkraftsreaktorn Forsmark 3 har stoppats helt. Nu kan redan höga elpriser stiga ytterligare i nästa vecka. ”Stoppet får stora konsekvenser för elpriset i södra Sverige framför allt”, säger elmarknadsanalytikern Christian Holtz.

en.title: Total shutdown at nuclear plant – could give a "double effect" on electricity prices
en.summary: The Forsmark 3 nuclear reactor has been completely shut down. Already high electricity prices could now rise further next week. "The shutdown will have major consequences for electricity prices in southern Sweden above all," says electricity market analyst Christian Holtz.
